app.QW1hem9uUzM.short_desc.source: Seamlessly connect to Amazon S3 to manage buckets, upload files, and automate your cloud storage workflows.
app.QW1hem9uUzM.short_desc.message: Seamlessly connect to Amazon S3 to manage buckets, upload files, and automate your cloud storage workflows.

app.QW1hem9uUzM.desc.source: The Amazon S3 integration provides comprehensive actions and triggers to interact with Amazon Simple Storage Service. Whether you need to manage buckets, upload and download files, or monitor changes to your S3 objects, this integration simplifies your cloud storage automation and file management workflows.
app.QW1hem9uUzM.desc.message: The Amazon S3 integration provides comprehensive actions and triggers to interact with Amazon Simple Storage Service. Whether you need to manage buckets, upload and download files, or monitor changes to your S3 objects, this integration simplifies your cloud storage automation and file management workflows.

app.QW1hem9uUzM.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source: Make a custom API call to Amazon S3

app.QW1hem9uUzM.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2Fsb.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Amazon S3** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
